fusions.name: Cold Rebuke
fusions.desc: A blow with cold iron that deals 30 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Tarnishing Wave
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A wave of sulphurous musk deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to tarnish its armour and leave it [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stood Its Ground
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds, and you have 20% more poison resistance while it holds.

fusions.name: Seasoned Like a Skillet
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 14%, and you have 10% poison resistance.
